compliance_decision:
1. Report the suspicious behavior as per Section 29 of the Financial Intelligence Centre Act, 2001 (Act No. 38 of 2001).
2. Guidance Note 4B on reporting of Suspicious and Unusual Transactions to the FIU under ACT 38/01 Section 29.
3. Upon detecting suspicious behavior, one must assess all known circumstances related to that situation including industry norms (Chunk 476-485). If a pattern of factors raises concern when combined with context and deviates from normal business practices or systems within the specific sector/industry where it arises, this constitutes grounds for suspicion. The behavior should then be reported to the Financial Intelligence Centre (FIU) as mandated by Section 29 of Act No.38 of 2001 which requires reporting such activities and transactions that are deemed unusual or potentially indicative of money laundering, terrorist financing, or other financial crimes for further investigation to ensure compliance with the act (Chunk 476-485).
